about: P1 R1 round 10: B with A's look. Her torso, breasts, hips and legs are A's, stored once on our topology as the designed slider her_a (tools/body/her_a_target.py -> base/targets/her_a_{tier}.npz; designed/her.json); arms and deltoids are the slider body's, weights, rig, correctives, clips and springs ours; the form library's r1 trunk sliders are off; round 12: the girdle and upper arm at A's own rest (her_a a_rest, a_tight).
skin_why: RETIRED P1 R1 round 35 (cavity_bounce 0; gate judge 3 faults 1 and 2): the bounce lit the inside of her armpit's folds wherever they face down, so the front fold's shaded crease read as a pale pinched lip over a dark notch (close, Look, idle, stalker) and the back fold as a bright rim (fight_close 375-377); B shot with --skin-set cavity_bounce=0 on round_35 (A's weights over the folds, a_axilla): both gone, the folds read as A's soft creases (r1c/round35/d/cav0.png). The cost: S3, the dark red-brown hollow under her raised arm (fight_stalker 359/371), comes back, and A shows it too. Was: P1 R1 round 33 (gate judge 2 S3, the armpit blot; A shows it too): as her arm lifts (fight_stalker 359/371) the hollow under it faces away from every lamp and the sky's ground gives it nothing (with scattering off it is black, Oklab L .06); Godot's skin scattering then paints it a dark red-brown blot (L .32, C .098, h 39). Not the albedo, AO, SSAO, shadows or the normals (B's posed geometric normals face away too). cavity_bounce: her own lit skin's light bounced into her armpit's hollow, where a lamp can't reach, by B's cavity map (bake.cavity; heroine_skin.gdshader cavity_*; P1Body.ApplySkin). At 0.3: the pit L .45, C .091, h 44 (skin in shade; lit skin beside it L .66).

seam.why: seam_g1 on A's tightly stripped neck rows: k 1 folded the first row over the second at the sides (14 folds, 177 deg); k 0.7 with the biharmonic ease round the sides: 0 folds, seam angle mean 3.0 (6.8 without), p95 6.4

bone_sliders_why: Soft tissue does not move bones, but A legs and trunk must hold their joints: read on the slider body the hip joint stood 12 mm wide of the fit and the knee 33 mm (x 154 against 121), so the bones are read on the body with her_a on. The r1 bone_sliders (the retired MakeHuman soft targets) are gone with the r1 trunk.

target_joints_ref.why: P1 R1 sliders: her_a's joints (A's, absolute) ride the landmark rules on any body with other sliders: landmark + (A's joint - the landmark on her_b) (build_topo.target_joints_ref); her_b itself keeps them absolute (same sliders).

a_joints.Head: Head
a_joints.why: P1 R1 rig root (round 24): B's trunk joints ARE A's (B's trunk is A's surface at A's rest), so the game turns B about A's points. Each B joint took its nearest A joint: B pelvis (with spine_01, which starts there) A's pelvis (B's was 22.7 mm lower, 14.8 back), spine_02 A's spine_01 (32 low), spine_03 A's spine_02, spine_04 A's spine_03 (47 low, 30 behind), neck_02 A's neck_01, Head A's Head (58 over, 24 in front); B's spine_05 (the clavicles' parent) and neck_01 stay where B's rules put them, inside A's spine_03 segment, and take its turn (P1Retarget: trunk turns as identities where joints coincide). Runtime layers turned B about other points: the fights' hands 16-36 mm off A's after three pose rounds of pivot patches, the head point at close 5.6 mm, the neck stretched to 0.826.

maps_bake.why: P1 R1 round 13 (skin): A's paint carried on round_12's surface (A's torso and, at A's rest, A's girdle and arm: projection p50 0.2-0.9 mm there, against 18-25 mm on the arms from her_ek2_final); one half's carry for both halves (averaging A's two halves halved its detail: the abs' slopes p50 1.84 -> 1.08 deg); A's whole form where we lie on A (A's navel is A's geometry, walls to 77 deg, which the 8-16 deg rule dropped), the old rule off A (hands, feet) Round 16 (bake round 2): carried on round_16 (B's normals A's file normals: the map holds A's own detail plus what B's interpolation misses), A's form = its file normals, the normal map's two halves averaged (each half's error vs A's shading p90 upper chest 1.88 -> 0.97, torso front 3.12 -> 1.58 against 'left'; A's detail is mirror-alike there, p90 0.5-0.9 apart), the paint one half's as before.
maps_bake.ring_flat_why: P1 R1 round 29 (S2, the thin dark line round her neck in the fights): the relief is B's own (flat) within 20 mm of the open neck ring, A's carry from 45 (topo_bake ring_flat). A's file normals bend 16-18 deg off A's surface over the seam's rows; carried as relief they drew a ridge 5-20 mm under the seam that read as a choker line when she turns her head (fight_close 353: gone with the body's relief off, there with head relief, shadows, SSAO, zones, SSS or paint off). The export normals already ease so (normals ring_mm).
maps_bake.carrier_why: Round 28: the carrier is round_28 (its hand on A's, a_hand): A's hand paint and nails carried onto the hand B now has; round_16 elsewhere

her_a.a_rest_why: P1 A shoulder (round 12): B's rest girdle and upper arm ARE A's (clavicle -14.9 deg, shoulder 41.5 mm under its head, arm -51.8 deg; A's joints from the target), so the game turns B from where A turns from. Measured: A's own skin taken through the old round trip (the fit's pose by A's weights, back by B's) alone gave cap p95 17-23 mm, armpit 13-28. The shoulder, upper arm and elbow are laid on A's skin (a_tight; the fit's arm is LOOSE, 10-23 mm off), fading to the fit's forearm (A girth, our flow) over the forearm (fading over the elbow alone left a step); the hand ours, riding rigidly. Forearm and hand keep the fit's direction: A's rest elbow bend is its carrying angle, which would make the hinge point forward.

seam_a.why: P1 R1 round 36 (gate judge 3 fault 5, the throat's cool patch at fight_close 353, B 905-925, 478-500: Oklab L .60 h 46 against A's .67 h 53; albedo, freckles' mask and relief are A's there, B's ring has no gap and the head's normals): under the seam B's rows leave A's surface 2-4 mm (dev, seam_g1's ease) and B's export normals there were B's own (ring_mm, dev_mm), posed at 353 p50 7.7-9.4 deg off A's at 3-35 mm under the ring (r1c/round36: nrm.py). A's file normals as they are (not turned by B's tilt), taken where B's point lies on A (the nearest of the target's points, inverse-distance over k), within 45 mm of the ring, eased out by 60: posed p50 2.4-4.8 deg (the floor, A's turned beyond 45 mm, 2.4).

normals.why: P1 R1 bake round 2 (round_16): B's export normals are A's FILE normals (posed as Godot skins them: what the game shades A with) where B lies on A, each half its own, least-squares fit over our triangles (the blend the game interpolates; point samples left p90 1.57 deg, the fit 1.29); B's own area-weighted normals there are B's facets over A's, p90 14 / p99 35 deg off on the upper chest, and the map that carried that correction from one half lit the other half wrong (round 1's lumps). near_mm = maps_bake form_near's (B on A); agree_cos keeps the other sheet out; dev_mm: where the built body leaves the target (the seam's rows) B's own. Measured (s/nmetric.py, texels both halves): vertex normal vs A's file p90 upper chest 5.14 -> 1.17, torso front 5.40 -> 2.35. ring_mm: B's own normals within 15 mm of the head's ring, A's from 45 (A's on the seam's rows stood the next row p90 10.3 deg off the ring's head normal, B's own 6.8).

a_foot.leg_joints_why: Round 30 (posed, after the foot): the foot's own shape on A (foot registered p95 5.3/6.7 mm, 1.2-1.6 deg) but the whole foot 19-26 mm off A's at the Look: the posed leg joints carry B's hip offset down unchanged (thigh head B - A (22.6, -17.7, 17.5) mm, foot (22.6, 5.1, 17.9); rest hip 32 mm off A's, knee 16), as the clips lay B's leg lines on A's. B's hip (the harrington rule) and knee (knee_tea) are A's at the a_rest pose (skeleton rule: joints), the twist, share and glute helpers riding the same rules.
a_foot.why: P1 R1 shape round 30 (gate judge 2 fault 1: pinched ankles, narrow feet pointing down, tiptoe). Measured on round_29 at the a_rest pose: B's foot 10.8/24.4 mm p50/p95 off A's (the fit's foot was never laid on A), the lowest shin rows to 21; B's ankle joint 44 mm under A's and 21 mm forward, B's rest foot line 15 deg flatter than A's, so the clips' foot turns (aligned onto A's rest by the shortest arc) pitched B's foot 15 deg down; posed foot vs A at the Look p95 27 mm. The foot laid on A's foot as a_tight lays the arm (point-to-plane + 0.1 point-to-point + lam |L U|^2, lam stepped down), fading over the shin (biharmonic; the shin is on A, p95 2 mm); joints: B's ankle cube, foot and ball ends and x axes are A's at that pose (her_a_target.a_joints), so the align is the identity there and A's foot turns carry A's foot whole.

crease_flat.why: P1 R1 round 31 (S1, the deltoid crease; gate judge 2): a dark line over the top of the shoulder cap as the arm lifts (fight_stalker 359/371, fight_close 353; A shows it too). Cause measured at fight_stalker ~359: not the paint, shadows, SSAO or the geometry (B's posed surface is smooth there); A's file normals, carried as B's export normals and as the relief, hold A's fold sculpted for the hanging arm (the shipped normals stand up to 20 deg off B's own posed surface in a curve on the line; the relief a +-15/128 ridge in R along it). The line (her left at rest, mirrored by x) from the shot's line pixels mapped through B's posed UVs. Within band_mm[0] B's own normals and a flat relief, A's from band_mm[1], smoothstep between (topo_bake.crease_keep; build_topo her_a_normals; her_a_target --maps).

a_hand.why: P1 R1 shape round 28 (gate judge 1 item 3): B's hand was ours (27% thinner, 13-20% shorter than A's; stiff and splayed at the Look and close-up). Our hand is laid on A's hand surface at the a_rest pose (her_a_target.ARest.hand_wrap) and B's hand and finger ends and x axes are A's (skeleton ends:/x:), so the clips' finger turns, rolled onto A's, carry A's hand whole. blend_m: the segments' blend (3 mm, ~ a joint's crease); ease_m: from the hand part's open edge (20 mm; the edge sits 21 mm from the wrist joint); lam as a_tight's. Posed hand vs A, round_27 -> trial: Look l/r 14.3/17.0 -> 1.6/5.2, close 12.1/18.2 -> 9.6/5.2 mm p95

a_lower_breast.why: P1 R1 shape round 30 (gate judge 2 fault 4: the right breast's lower curve comes to a point at the close-up and in idle_close). Measured on round_29 at the close (s/brpole.py, brw.py): B at rest on A (lower pole p95 1.5 mm), the correctives and the springs change it < 0.3 mm; the cause is the skinning: B's height steps hand the lower pole to the spine under the breast (B spine_03 = A's spine_02: 0.55 at the bottom eighth, A 0.20) and the skirt's upper-chest share falls 0.44 -> 0 within 40 mm (A 0.72 -> 0.14 over 70 mm). A's weights there (round_29 re-skinned, s/brx.py): close bottom-middle p95 r 4.8 -> 1.6, l 2.0 -> 1.1 mm, breasts 5.7 -> 5.2, Look 4.3 -> 3.8. map: A's trunk bones onto B's by the matched joints (her_a a_joints), the breast and the girdle by name; y_frac 0.5 (the lower half; the upper breast and its clavicle share kept), fade_m 80 mm (A's skirt share at 70 mm 0.14).

a_shoulder_top.why: P1 R1 shape round 30 (gate judge 2 fault 5: the left cap about 4 px wider at the front Look). Measured on round_30 build5 (r1c/round30/s/sil2.py, trx2.py): the cap and upper arm edges sit on A's within 1-2 px; the difference is the trapezius' slope from the neck to the acromion, B 19-28 px out of A's silhouette at the Look (left; right 29 px), trapezius box p95 8.7/5.4 mm. B gave the slope to upperarm_share (0.67; A: clavicle 0.33, upper chest spine_03 0.26, trap 0.23) and B's clavicle skin never takes A's roll (girdle clavicle_roll neutral; at the Look B's clavicle skin turns the slope's points 11 mm off A's). A's weights mapped by role, A's clavicle and trapezius onto B's trapezius helper, which keeps the clip's roll (rig_girdle clavicle_roll_keep): trapezius p95 Look 8.7/5.4 -> 4.7/1.0, close 4.4/8.9 -> 3.1/2.3, chest 8.6/5.4 -> 5.7/3.5, close chest_r 10.3 -> 5.9; silhouette 19-28 px -> 0-9 px; caps held (Look 3.1 -> 2.7, close 1.6 -> 1.5). neck_d/ease: the neck part (the head seam) kept B's; x_full 145 mm then 35% of A's out to 200 mm (A's in full to the acromion pulls the lateral slope 12-16 px under A's and the close cap 1.6 -> 3.8 mm). Round 35 (gate judge 3 fault 6, a knob on top of the left deltoid at the Look): the 35% share left the cap's top (x 174-191 mm, y 1535-1549) a 35/65 mix of A's weights and B's own (B share 0.85; A clavicle 0.38, share 0.21, twist 0.12, delt 0.11), 2-4.7 mm outside A's at the Look; with a_axilla A's and lat_share 1.0 (r1c/round35/s/pit.py, rul.sh on round 34's probes): cap top Look p95/max 3.2/4.7 -> 0.9/1.4 mm, ruler cap_l Look 2.1|2.8 -> 0.7|1.1, close 1.6|2.1 -> 0.8|1.5, the rest held.

a_elbow.why: P1 R1 round 32 (gate judge 2 fault 3: the armband ink about 1.5 times A's width, the lower band most, the zigzag uneven). Measured on round_31 (r1c/round32/s/band.py, bandpose.py, elbprof.py): the carry keeps the band at rest (edge ratio p50 1.000, p95 1.01); posed at the Look B's lower band's edges stretch p50 1.14-1.22, p95 1.45-1.51 of rest (A's 1.04, its bone scale), the skinning alone (the shapes add nothing): B's elbow blend reaches 15-30 mm further up the upper arm than A's (the lower chain's share at 40-50 mm over the joint B 0.29, A 0.01; 50% at B 33 mm, A 21 mm; zero by A 50 mm, B 90 mm), so the Look's 20-30 degree elbow bend drags the band's lower edge. A's weights mapped by name from 20-40 mm over the joint (the elbow's own crease and point kept B's) to 120 mm, eased out by 140.

a_neck.why: P1 R1 round 32 (gate judge 2 fault 6: the throat blot at fight_close 353, a purple bruise-like spot under the head's seam, B's stronger than A's faint line). Measured on round_31 (r1c/round32/s/throat.py, neckw.py; d/fc_B*.png): the spot survives noao, flathead and (fainter) flatbody: it is the surface, not the maps; posed at 353 B's throat 10-40 mm under the seam sits 6-9 mm inside A's with its normals 11-19 degrees off, at rest on A's (p50/p95 0.9/2.5 mm). A's neck rides the head (Head 0.74-0.80 at the seam, 0.5-0.6 at 30-45 mm, 0.2 at 50-80 mm), B's rode neck_02 / neck_01 (Head 0.00-0.19), so the fight's head turn left B's throat behind and dented it at the seam. A's weights mapped by role over the neck part (A's neck_01 = B's neck_02, the spine one up, A's clavicle onto B's trapezius helper as a_shoulder_top), full to 50 mm under the seam, eased out by 80; the head's weights are the ring's, so both sides of the seam take A's turn.

a_axilla.why: P1 R1 round 35 (gate judge 3 faults 1 and 2: the front armpit fold a bright pinched lip over a dark notch at the close-up, Look and idle; the back-armpit pinch at fight_close 375-377). Measured on round_33 (r1c/round35/s/pit.py, wcmp.py, selfn.py): B's rest is on A's over the folds (0.1-1.6 mm p95); B's front fold rode its spine (spine_04 0.44, share 0.02; A: lat/spine 0.39, share 0.18, twist_02 0.26), its pit and back fold its share (0.31-0.40, A 0.20-0.21), and B's share lags A's 20 deg on a hanging arm (rig girdle's hanging branch): the posed export normals in the right pit stood 28-43 deg (median) off B's own surface, A's 18-30. A's weights by role: A's lat, pec and scap never turn off A's spine_03 (B's spine_04), A's delt rides A's twist_02 rigidly, A's clavicle is B's trap (a_shoulder_top).

a_thigh.why: P1 R1 round 32 (the butt ruler, butt the priority: B's left inner lower butt by the gluteal cleft up to 35 mm inside A's at the stance, p95 Look 26.1, close 29.0, right 9.2). Measured on round_31 (r1c/round32/s/butt.py, buttw.py, buttloc.py, hipang.py): at rest B is on A there (p50/p95 1.4/2.1 mm); the points 5-40 mm off are the thigh part's inner top behind, 110-240 mm under the hip joint, 20-120 mm off the crotch strip, where the hip pin's fill gives B pelvis 0.48-0.59 and thigh_share 0.39-0.50 against A's thigh 0.87-0.94; the stance turns B's left thigh 13 degrees in and the right 7 out, so B's inner thigh stays with the pelvis (left -24 mm mean, inside; right +9, outside). A's weights mapped by role over the thigh's inner top (to 260 mm under the joint, eased out by 320; the crotch strip's 15 mm and the hip's side past x 70 mm kept B's).

weights.why: P1 R1 shape round 30 (gate judge 2 fault 1, the ankle's sharp crease): B's calf -> foot ramp was 50 mm (all foot 20 mm under the ankle joint, all calf 30 over); A's own, measured on heroine.glb's bind (foot + ball share by height over A's ankle along the calf, her left, 10 mm bands): 0.93 at -55 mm, 0.72 at -5, 0.50 at +15, 0.26 at +45, 0.13 at +75, a 195 mm ramp from -80 (least squares, smoothstep: residual 0.015 over 15 bands). The ball's: A 0.17 at t 0.55, 0.53 at 0.95, 0.92 at 1.35 along the foot bone -> [0.23, 1.4] (residual 0.003). B's foot and its joints are A's (her_a a_foot), so A's ramps are A's skinning there.

cavity.why: P1 R1 round 33 (S3): cavity.png, B's AO kept within radius_mm of line_m (B's rest, mirrored): from her armpit's apex (the shoulder part's lowest point; r1c/round32/s/pitmaps.py: AO .38 there) to the hollow the blot showed in at fight_stalker 358 (its pixels mapped to B's rest: 89-112 mm from the apex, AO .65-.89), white beyond; the skin's cavity_bounce reads it. Over all of B's AO the bounce lifted the shade under her breasts, her cleavage and inner elbows at the Look (r1c/round33/v/cav_diff.png).

pieces.why: P1 R1 round 29 (gate judge 1 item 6): A's zigzag tattoos are an outfit piece, reaver.ink (the ink slot, navy cloth 1.2-1.4 mm off A's skin), which B could not wear (P1Laws leaves A's outfit meshes off B). Every ink-slot piece of every heroine outfit (and its outfit's gameplay lod_ink, onto play.glb's body) is carried by its surface point onto B's rest and skinned with B's weights and shapes there (tools/body/skin_pieces.py); P1Body.Piece wears B's carry on A's node, so the slot's rules and A's material hold.

rig_girdle.why: A1 rebase on B (9 Nov, the owner: no more of A's runtime code goes into B): clavicle_by law: B's own girdle law (rig_drive.girdle, P1Rig.ClavicleTurn) lifts the clavicle from the clip's; A's HerShrug no longer runs on B (P1Rig.ShrugDriven false); P4 clips key the clavicle neutral (Marionette motion/clip.py NEUTRAL) so the lift is laid once; the bridge clips key A's clavicle before A's shrug, so they take B's lift once too. Rig step alone: build_topo.py --rig-only. Round 30 (clavicle_roll_keep trap): the trapezius helper keeps the clip's (A's) clavicle roll, so A's top of the shoulder, which rides A's clavicle, can (weights.a_shoulder_top). Round 27 (clavicle_roll neutral): the clips key A's clavicle as mapped, roll and all, so the game's local-space blends of clavicle and upper arm run as A's (round 26 baked B's own roll into the keys and the fights' upper arms ran 1-3 deg off A's through blends); B's laws (rig_drive.girdle, P1Rig) then lay the clavicle on its line by the least turn from its neutral, handing the roll to the upper arm (its world kept), so B's clavicle skin never takes A's roll (round 25: breasts 4.3 -> 10.3 mm p95 at the Look).P1 R1 arm chain: B's clavicle is the clip's (P1Retarget's map of A's, with align; B's clavicle head and shoulder are A's) and A's own HerShrug lifts it at runtime where A runs it (People.Heroine, on B by role), instead of the girdle law's clavicle turn: A blends her clips and then shrugs, so B baked A's shrug and laid its own law on top, and the fights' arms ran 1-3 deg off A's (hands 11-19 mm p95). The scapula's rows stay B's.
